messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: This dose is also administered postoperatively if nausea and/or vomiting occur shortly after surgery.
The use of this medication is for the prevention of postoperative nausea and vomiting.
Usual Pediatric Dose for Nausea/Vomiting -- Chemotherapy Induced:
The recommended oral dose for children aged 4 to 11 years is 4 mg taken three times a day.
The first oral dose for this age group is administered 30 minutes before the start of chemotherapy.
Subsequent oral doses for this age group are given 4 and 8 hours after the first dose.
After the initial doses, the oral regimen continues as 4 mg three times a day every 8 hours.
This continued oral dosing lasts for 1 to 2 days after the completion of chemotherapy.
The recommended oral dose for individuals 12 years and older is 8 mg taken twice a day.
The first oral dose for this age group is administered 30 minutes before the start of chemotherapy.
The subsequent oral dose for this age group is given 8 hours later.
After the initial doses, the oral regimen continues as 8 mg twice a day every 12 hours.
Triplet: ["Ondansetron", "used for", "prevention of postoperative nausea and vomiting"]

The relation 'used for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is indicated or utilized for the medical purpose or condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'used during': The subject drug is administered or utilized during the specific phase or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
